You are not allowed to import APIHUB Portal components in APIHUB Shared.

You are not allowed to import APIHUB Portal or Agents in APIHUB Shared -- by a relative path either. The rules above name the packages, and a relative path matched none of them. Shared is a library: the apps depend on it, never the reverse. See the comment in src/hooks/frontend-version/useVersionInfo.ts.
